_readme: Hand-checked facts per building, keyed by index in GEO.buildings. Fields (all optional): floors, wall (hex), trim (hex, slab/ledge paint), parapet (hex), shops (true/false), roof ('tin'|'flat'), roofCol (hex, tin roofs), style ('rcc'|'slide'|'assam'|'blank'), unfinished (bool), conf ('high'|'medium'|'low' = how sure the Street View match is), note. Panos: Google Street View, Mar 2026 imagery, viewed 2026-10-15; 'x -357 S' = looking south from the pano at local x = -357 on Mother Teresa Rd.

_survey.note: Street View between Hatigarh Chariali and the mandir: mostly walled residential compounds. Inside this x range a building only gets shopfronts if it is marked shops: true here.
